notes.title: Haunted Paws: Closed Alpha Begins
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="S0BNgOf3ixk;full"][/previewyoutube][h1][b]Haunted Paws: Closed Alpha Begins – Announced at Wholesome Direct 2025[/b][/h1][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally share that the [b]Closed Alpha for Haunted Paws is beginning[/b], and we’ll be inviting players to test the game in small waves starting today![/p][p]Before diving into the details, we want to take a moment to thank you for your continued patience and support. We know it’s taken longer than expected to reach this stage — and we’d love to share why.[/p][h3][b]Why It Took Time – A Process of Testing and Listening[/b][/h3][p]As a small team, we’ve been focused on building something special: a cozy co-op horror experience where you and a friend play as brave little puppies exploring a haunted world. Getting the tone and feel right has taken time — especially because early on, we explored multiple directions in how the game could play.[/p][p]In our initial prototypes, the game featured a [b]third-person, semi-open world[/b] structure. Players could explore large areas, switch between characters, solve puzzles, and fight enemies. It looked great, and in some moments, it really shined. We even imagined a wide range of player-driven exploration, with environments like forests, apartments, crypts, and graveyards — and we built early versions of all of that[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/dff4fdb3992c4e6c6c07c3760f729dcf784fa623.gif"][/img][/p][p]But through internal testing and lots of play sessions, we started to notice that something was missing. The spooky, atmospheric tone that’s so important to [i]Haunted Paws[/i] often got lost in the open layout. Movement felt too loose. Pacing was inconsistent. And local co-op, a central feature of the game, became harder to design around in those wide spaces.[/p][p]We weren’t sure whether to keep going in that direction or refine things. So we turned to the community — and ran a poll that nearly [b]3,000 of you[/b] responded to. Your feedback showed a strong interest in a [b]more focused, atmospheric experience[/b] — something that would lean into mood, tension, storytelling, and handcrafted moments, like in [i]INSIDE[/i], [i]Little Nightmares[/i], or [i]Limbo[/i].[/p][p]That helped confirm what we had already begun feeling during internal testing: [i]Haunted Paws[/i] would thrive in a more directed format, where pacing, scares, exploration, and emotional beats can be carefully shaped and shared.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/20fc78675b006fc5a734cf94d01c2043c701e06f.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Private Alpha Testing Starts Now[/b][/h3][p]To manage feedback effectively, we’re rolling the alpha out in [b]three phases[/b], all focused on [b]local co-op[/b] for now.[/p][p][b]Phase 1 – Available Now[/b][/p][list][*][p]Local co-op only[/p][/*][*][p]Focus: puppy customization, controller support, and movement[/p][/*][*][p]Goal: ensure the basics feel great and technical stuff is bug-free[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Phase 2 – In a few weeks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Local co-op only[/p][/*][*][p]Adds: enemies, puzzles, early story content[/p][/*][*][p]Goal: test core interactions and early atmosphere [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Phase 3 – Later one[/b][/p][list][*][p]Local co-op only[/p][/*][*][p]Adds: 30–50 minutes of full gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Goal: test a full early-game slice with story, exploration, and progression
[/p][/*][/list][p]Access links will be sent [b]daily[/b] to everyone who signs up.[/p][p]After Phase 3 wraps, we’ll move into [b]online co-op support[/b] and prepare a [b]public demo[/b], which we’re aiming to launch around [b]Halloween[/b], alongside new content.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Want to help us test Haunted Paws?
[/b] 📩 Sign up for Alpha Access: [url="https://lazyflock.com/join"]Haunted Paws Closed Alpha[/url]
 💬 Join the discussion on Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/yTQPvTSR9p"]Haunted Paws Discord[/url][/p][p]Thank you again for being on this journey with us. Your support — and feedback — have directly shaped the path of [i]Haunted Paws[/i]. We can’t wait to see what you think.[/p][p]— The Haunted Paws Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: How we plan to develop Haunted Paws!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/9c44341bcc11e1881b020e81bd3e6867ee092499.png[/img][h1]Greetings, Puppy Pals![/h1]
This is officially the first news update on the Haunted Paws Steam page! First of all, make sure to Wishlist and Follow the game! We plan to post updates about the development and it will be visible in your library if you follow the game!

[h1]Watch our Announcement Trailer![/h1]
If you still haven't see it yet, check out the Announcement trailer we posted on Youtube here:
[previewyoutube=EzOkMteLPnA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Become a Game Insider![/h1]
Also you can join our [url=https://www.patreon.com/LazyFlockStudio]Patreon[/url] (we have free tier) to follow our development journey and give us suggestions. Right know you can vote on which dog breeds should be included in our game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/074a7b036cfd5f371d1c22caf3239615f3c4f09d.gif[/img]

[h1]Upcoming Demo[/h1]
Currently, we're developing the first Demo of the game, which we plan to release in a few months. Our task is to create a demo that allows you to design your own puppy and customize it with various accessories. Make sure you follow our game on Steam so you don't miss when it comes out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/b3cb74d64b04107f208573cf9fccda31d832d72f.gif[/img]

Cheers,
Mantas & Martynas
